descriptions.interaction: Upload/locate XML/RDF data; inspect generated schema; drag/drop query clauses and schema values; connect mappings; choose RETURN/CONSTRUCT output; execute,export and save/reuse mashups
descriptions.guidance: Automatically generated XSD/RDFS schemas,clause/function palette and schema-based variable input support composition
descriptions.visualisation: Schema tree with optional list/grid/graph views; connected query components; graph/table/list results
